questionEn: What conclusion on the topic “The Atom and its Structure” can be considered correct?
questionUz: "Atom va uning tuzilishi" mavzusi bo'yicha qanday xulosani to'g'ri deb hisoblash mumkin?
choicesEn: Positively charged particle of the nucleus of an atom
explanationEn: Proton p⁺ is part of the nucleus, charge +1.
explanationUz: Proton p⁺ yadroning bir qismi, zaryad +1.
